description_zh: 新建一条命令助手命令
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name testName --type RunShellScript --command-content ifconfig_-s --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCommand

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the command. All character sets are supported. The name can be up to 128 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 命令名称，支持全字符集。长度不得超过128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the command. All character sets are supported. The description can be up to 512 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 命令描述，支持全字符集。长度不得超过512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the command. Valid values:

RunBatScript: Bat commands for Windows instances.

RunPowerShellScript: PowerShell commands for Windows instances.

RunShellScript: Shell commands for Linux instances
parameters.help_zh:
命令的语言类型。取值范围：

RunBatScript：适用于Windows实例的Bat命令。
RunPowerShellScript：适用于Windows实例的PowerShell命令。
RunShellScript：适用于Linux实例Shell命令
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The content of the command. Note the following:

Set `EnableParameter` to \`true\` to enable custom parameters in the command content.

Define custom parameters in the \`{{}}\` format. Spaces and line feeds before and after parameter names within \`{{}}\` are ignored.

You can define up to 20 custom parameters.

Custom parameter names can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The names are case-insensitive.

A single custom parameter name cannot exceed 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
命令内容。您需要注意：

指定参数`EnableParameter=true`可在命令内容中启用自定义参数功能：
用{{}}包含的方式定义自定义参数，在`{{}}`内参数名前后的空格以及换行符会被忽略。
自定义参数个数不能超过20个。
自定义参数名允许a-zA-Z0-9-_的组合，不支持其余字符，参数名不区分大小写。
单个自定义参数名不能超过64字节
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en:
The directory where the command is run on the ECS instance.

Default values:

For Linux instances: The home directory of the \`root\` user, which is the `/root` directory.

For Windows instances: The directory where the Cloud Assistant client process is located, such as `C:\Windows\System32`
parameters.help_zh:
您创建的命令在ECS实例中运行的目录。

默认值： 
Linux实例：管理员root用户的home目录下，具体为`/root`目录。  
Windows实例：云助手客户端进程所在目录，例如`C:\Windows\System32`
parameters.name: working_dir

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for the command to run on the server instance, in seconds.

When a command task times out, Cloud Assistant forcibly stops the task process. The timeout period must be between 10 and 86,400 seconds (24 hours).

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
设置命令在服务器实例中的超时时间，单位为秒。

当执行命令的任务超时后，命令助手将强制终止任务进程。可设定超时时间取值范围为10～86400秒（24小时）。

默认值：60
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use custom parameters in the command.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
创建的命令是否使用自定义参数。

默认值为false
parameters.name: enable_parameter

fields.help_en:
The key of tag N to add to the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`. It cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
为命令指定的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of tag N to add to the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
为命令指定的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
